title: Keto Irish Trout Stir Fry
description: A keto-friendly Chinese-inspired stir fry dish made with Irish trout, crispy vegetables, and a hint of Asian spices.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the trout fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
3. Remove the trout from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil to the skillet.
5. Add the crispy vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
6. Add the soy sauce, garlic, ginger, chili flakes, and sesame seeds to the skillet.
7. Stir-fry the vegetables for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
8. Return the trout to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
9. Serve the keto Irish trout stir fry hot, garnished with green onions and additional sesame seeds if desired.
